Official catalog contains 31 cards including one coming-soon title; parsed frontmatter comparison of every card name, Lucky Knight page slug and provider name across Game and Provider names, original and Traditional Chinese names, aliases, provider and gameId found no matches. Official catalog lists six named titles, including Cyber Grid with Slot specifications and top-played status; the page was retrieved directly with HTTP 200 after sandbox DNS failed. Parsed exact comparison of all six titles and provider name against existing local Game and Provider names, aliases and gameId found no match. A different Nocturn Play catalog also contains a Neon Ronin with different described artwork and mechanics; their identity is unresolved and neither Neon Ronin is being imported. Cyber Grid has no attributable image or verified exact demo; neither absence blocks capture.

Official portfolio identifies five released Slots. Parsed frontmatter comparison of all five titles, Frozen Fortune's normalized title and Terra Gaming against local Game and Provider names, original and Traditional Chinese names, aliases, provider and gameId found no match. Official portfolio supplies the 5x3 layout, 20 lines and RTP; its game-specific artwork was retrieved and visually inspected. The maximum is not converted to a bet multiple without an explicit basis. The exact same-game entry remains unverified.
